description: This file defines types and a class for handling user notification permissions and scheduling in an iOS app. It includes an enum for authorization status, a protocol for notification center interactions, and a concrete implementation that uses UserNotifications framework.

classes.name: LiveNotificationCenter
classes.description: A concrete implementation of NotificationCentering that interacts with the system's notification center, handling authorization status queries and request submissions.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current notification authorization status.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Requests user authorization for notifications with specified options.
